Reema (FinOps): Quick check-in after postmortem. We saw sporadic +11% token inflation on a small cohort. Need owners: backfill, invoice corrections, recurrence detection, comms.
Hugo (Eng-Infra): I can take the backfill and the dedupe guard. Plan: patch canary tonight, staging smoke tomorrow AM, backfill next-day 02:00 UTC.
Laila (Metering): Ill own detection rules and dashboards. Propose: page if >=9% in 2h, warn in slack for >=4% in 24h. Add min-token cutoff 2k and require 2 consecutive windows.
Marco (SRE): Ill handle ledger reconciliation and the invoice reissue flow. Need impacted list from FinOps and a dry-run slot.
Reema (FinOps): Uploaded impacted_customers_1843.csv to FIN-612. tagging customers for later comms after dry-run.
Hugo (Eng-Infra): Quick validation query Ill run on staging:
SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, SUM(tokens) tokens FROM token_events WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY customer_id, hr ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 30;
Hugo (Eng-Infra): Staging smoke passed on canary; root cause looks like a retry that reprocessed a window. Patch merged to canary.
Laila (Metering): PR opened: github.com/redwood/meters/pull/612  adds dashboard panels + example notebook. Requesting review from @Hugo and @Marco.
Marco (SRE): Reconcile script draft at //ops/billing/reconcile_backfill.sh. Dry-run scheduled Mon 09:30 UTC. Will include pro-rata credit calc and a rollback flag.
reissue-bot: Reissue job queued id=rb-20241201-03 (FIN-612) status=queued.
Reema (FinOps): Owners & deadlines recap: Hugo - patch canary tonight, staging smoke tomorrow AM, prod backfill 02:00 UTC next day. Laila - detection rules + dashboards by Fri AM. Marco - reconcile script + dry-run Mon 09:30 UTC. Finance will prepare comms after successful dry-run. Please post short status updates here so I can close FIN-612 to "postmortem actions" when done. :thumbsup:
